qa.title: Q625 (Apr. 12, 2024)
qa.question: If I put Spartoi Sergeant onto my field with this follower's Fanfare ability, can I play Spartoi Sergeant's Fanfare ability before giving it +1/+1?
qa.answer: No. You finish resolving this follower's Fanfare ability before playing Spartoi Sergeant's Fanfare ability.

qa.title: Q591 (Apr. 12, 2024)
qa.question: When playing this follower's Fanfare ability, do I give +1/+1 (or +3/+3) to each follower on my field other than this follower, or other than the Abysscraft followers I just put from my cemetery onto my field?
qa.answer: You give the buff to each follower on your field other than this follower.

qa.title: Q590 (Apr. 12, 2024)
qa.question: If I have exactly 10 cards in my cemetery when I play this follower's Fanfare ability, does Necrocharge (10) still trigger? If I have exactly 20, does Necrocharge (20) still trigger?
qa.answer: Yes, and yes. Necrocharge references the number of cards in your cemetery at the moment the effect with Necrocharge begins to be resolved.
